site_name: Land At Shoreditch Park, North Of Dorothy Thurtle Gardens And Adjacent To Pitfield Street, South Of The Approved Leisure Centre, Currently In Use As A Temporary Energy Centre
description: Variation of condition 4 (time limit) attached to planning permission ref 2019/3660 dated 28/02/2020 for the Erection of temporary energy centre and temporary gas metre housing to the south of the approved Leisure Centre.
decision_conditions:
<p>No flues, ductwork or any other pipework shall be fixed to the elevations of
the adjacent leisure centre building other than as shown on the drawings
hereby approved.
</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is
satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the
area.</p>

<p>The hereby approved development shall be undertaken in full accordance
with the Arboricultural Method Statement by CBA Trees dated Sept 2019 (ref:
CBA10997v1). This includes the requirement that all excavation within Root
Protection Areas shall be undertaken by hand, using hand tools and under
arboricultural supervision, with a methodology to be adopted when excavating
and encountering roots.
</p><p>REASON: In order to safeguard the health of adjacent trees and the
contribution that they make to the amenity of the surrounding area.</p>

<p>The acoustic louvre details approved under 2021/0467 shall be retained and maintained for the duration of the planning permission hereby approved. Alternatively, details of acoustic louvres capable of preventing noise breakout from the Temporary Energy Centre, to a level specified within the Noise
Impact Report by Buro Happold Engineering (submitted with this application),
shall be submitted for approval by the local planning authority, prior to any change to the operation of the Temporary Energy Centre.&nbsp; The approved details shall be installed prior to the operational change taking place, and shall be retained and maintained thereafter.
</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the amenity of surrounding occupiers and the area
generally, from increased noise levels emitted as a result of the development.</p>

<p>The reinstatement landscaping scheme hereby approved and as indicated
within plan T5073-EC-CLA-GF-DR-L-1011 P6 (or any subsequently approved
plans) shall be carried out within the first planting (and seeding) season
following the removal of the temporary energy centre and gas meter cabinet,
and shall be maintained to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority for
a period of ten years, such maintenance to include the replacement of any
plants that die, or are severely damaged, seriously diseased, or removed.
</p><p>REASON: To ensure the appearance of the site is satisfactory.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The development hereby permitted shall be for a limited period only and shall be removed from the site no later than 30th June 2028, or within six months of the permanent Colville Estate Energy Centre becoming operational, whichever is sooner. By that time, the temporary energy centre, gas meter cabinet, and any associated services and structures shall be removed from the site, and the land reinstated.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-34ee8b28-7fff-dff3-f902-99907ec1746c"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: The appearance of the development would detract from the appearance of the parent building and surrounding area if retained on a permanent basis.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Noise levels from fixed plant and machinery associated with the proposed development shall be 5dB(A) or more below the background noise level when measured at any nearby noise sensitive premises at any time.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-fc164801-7fff-9c41-653b-6b440c2b941b"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that occupiers of the neighbouring premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance from fixed plant and machinery</span></p>
